name: H-Kay AI OS Completion Constitution
principles: No agent may claim COMPLETE from implementation evidence alone.
The implementation agent must not be the independent reviewer.
CI and code tests are evidence, not independent review.
Customer-visible or production-affecting claims require end-to-end evidence where applicable.
A failed or missing required check keeps the task fail-closed.
Commercial configuration drift is a release blocker.
Production writes, live billing changes and capability enablement remain separately gated.

risk_rules.production_change: Requires explicit founder approval evidence and must not be inferred from CI success.
risk_rules.live_billing_change: Requires explicit founder approval evidence plus Stripe/customer-journey verification.
risk_rules.customer_delivery: Requires inspectable output evidence matching the task definition of done.
